local frame = 0
local path = [[{{PROJECT_ROOT}}/Saved/Bindings.profile]]
function Ready(self, dt)
 assert(CallFunction("Input.OpenRebindProfile", {context="/Game/Input/NewInputMappingContext.21kbinputcontext", path=path}).opened)
 assert(CallFunction("Input.ResetRebind", {}).reset)
 assert(CallFunction("Input.BeginRebind", {binding="1"}).started)
end
function Tick(self, dt)
 frame = frame + 1
 if frame == 1 then assert(CallFunction("Input.PollRebind", {}).state == "listening") end
 if frame == 2 then
  local result = CallFunction("Input.PollRebind", {})
  assert(result.state == "conflict" and result.conflict == "2")
 end
 if frame == 3 then assert(CallFunction("Input.PollRebind", {swapConflict=true}).state == "applied") end
 if frame == 4 then
  assert(CallFunction("Input.BeginRebind", {binding="1"}).started)
  assert(CallFunction("Input.CancelRebind", {}).canceled)
  assert(CallFunction("Input.PollRebind", {}).state == "canceled")
  assert(CallFunction("Input.BeginRebind", {binding="1"}).started)
 end
 if frame == 5 then
  assert(CallFunction("Input.PollRebind", {}).state == "applied")
  Log("rebind-workflow-pass")
 end
end
